title: More than a platform
sub: The film that follows The Inner Life of Data: what the Learning Data portal is, why it exists, its route of stations from the foundations to leading data people, its example dbt project with the business and governance metadata beside the code, and what a visitor can do at every stop.
howto: The film is drawn on the dark navy map of The Inner Life of Data. The blue line is the suggested route, the amber branch line is sharing and protecting, and the violet branch line is agents, as on the Topics page. Gold is what people agree on, and the thread of enterprise data architecture. The tools' pages are drawn for the film, with their official logos.
